method: Independent analytic derivation with numerical checks, separate from rendered labels
claims: For external rotation axis R>r, every cross-section area element dA at radius rho sweeps volume 2pi rho dA. Symmetric pairs at R-s and R+s average to travel 2pi R. Integrating yields V=2pi R times pi r squared.
This is a limiting integral argument. Finite drawn squares illustrate pairs, not an exact finite tessellation. An axis crossing the disk creates overlaps and invalidates this simple argument.

checks.description: Independent shell integration matches volume formula
Paired travel average equals centroid journey

limitations: Numerical samples check implementations; general conclusions rest on the stated mathematical arguments.
